strategy: This LeNet-5 reference is split by semantic detail units: top layer clusters, local operation insets, and the fully connected node inset. The count is image-specific and can change for another reference.

components.name: Input image and red source pixel
relationships: red source pixel maps to lower 5x5 convolution input grid
black connector lines continue into C1

components.name: C1 feature-map stack and first convolution marker
relationships: green selected C1 cell maps to lower pooling inset
red output cell relates to first convolution output grid

components.name: S2 subsampling stack
must_notice: blue C3 receptive-field box entering next crop
relationships: S2 feeds C3 through black connector lines
blue square continues into C3 convolution detail

components.name: C3 feature-map stack and S4 bridge
relationships: blue C3 square maps to lower 3x3 convolution grid
green S4 square continues to C5 full connection

components.name: S4 stack to C5 layer
relationships: S4 maps fully connect to C5
magenta marker maps to lower C5 grid detail

components.name: C5, F6, output, and class digits
relationships: cyan arrows point to the lower fully connected columns
class digits correspond to output labels

components.name: Lower 5x5 convolution input grid
relationships: red arrow arrives from input source pixel
red dashed guides continue to small output grid

components.name: Lower 5x5 convolution output cells
relationships: receives red dashed projection from the 7x7 convolution grid

components.name: Lower 2x2 pooling detail
relationships: green arrow arrives from C1 selected cell

components.name: Lower 3x3 convolution detail
relationships: blue arrow arrives from C3 selected square
blue dashed guides connect input window to output grid

components.name: C5 full-connection grid detail
relationships: magenta arrow arrives from C5 marker

components.name: Fully connected network inset
relationships: cyan arrows arrive from C5, F6, and output bands
